title: 🎉 Free Promotion on FreeTV Garden — Today Only!
text:
🌍 **Promote your online presence for FREE!** Individuals, creators and businesses worldwide can request a sponsored placement for their website, app, product, social media account, channel or online community.

**All available positions and card sizes are free for 24 hours during this offer.** The first applicant to contact us with complete details and receive confirmation gets priority for the Top position.
moreLabel: Full offer details, eligible accounts & slot prices
more:
**🎁 FREE PROMOTION — TODAY ONLY**

For this limited-time offer, eligible users from **any country** can request any available sponsored position and card size on FreeTV Garden for **₹0 for 24 hours**. Bookings are subject to review, availability and confirmation.

**📣 WHAT CAN YOU PROMOTE?**

**Social media accounts and profiles**
- Instagram accounts and creator profiles
- Facebook pages and profiles
- X (Twitter), Threads, Pinterest, LinkedIn and Snapchat accounts
- TikTok accounts where available
- Other legitimate social media profiles

**Video, streaming and creator channels**
- YouTube channels, videos and Shorts
- Twitch and other streaming profiles
- Podcasts, music pages and creator portfolios

**Messaging channels and communities**
- Telegram channels, groups and bots
- Discord servers and communities
- WhatsApp Channels and communities
- Other legitimate online communities

**Websites, apps and digital projects**
- Websites, blogs, portfolios and online magazines
- Android apps, web apps, software and browser extensions
- Free online tools and open-source projects
- Educational resources and personal projects

**Businesses, services and products**
- Startups, online stores and local businesses
- Freelancers, agencies and professional services
- Physical and digital products
- Ebooks, courses, templates and other legitimate offerings
- Events, organizations and community projects

You **do not need to own a website** to apply. You can request promotion for an eligible social media account, channel, group, profile, app, product or other online presence.

**👥 WHO CAN APPLY?**

Individuals, students, content creators, influencers, developers, freelancers, website owners, startups, businesses and organizations from any country can apply. All submissions must comply with the content rules below and are subject to approval.

**📐 AVAILABLE POSITIONS AND SIZES**

🥇 **POSITION 1 — TOP**
- Large: **FREE** (regular price ₹99/24h)
- Medium: **FREE** (regular price ₹79/24h)
- Small: **FREE** (regular price ₹59/24h)

⭐ **POSITION 2 — FEATURED**
- Large: **FREE** (regular price ₹79/24h)
- Medium: **FREE** (regular price ₹59/24h)
- Small: **FREE** (regular price ₹39/24h)

🔥 **POSITION 3 — FEATURED**
- Large: **FREE** (regular price ₹59/24h)
- Medium: **FREE** (regular price ₹39/24h)
- Small: **FREE** (regular price ₹29/24h)

📢 **POSITION 4 — SPONSORED**
- Large: **FREE** (regular price ₹39/24h)
- Medium: **FREE** (regular price ₹29/24h)
- Small: **FREE** (regular price ₹19/24h)

📌 **POSITION 5 — SPONSORED**
- Large: **FREE** (regular price ₹29/24h)
- Medium: **FREE** (regular price ₹19/24h)
- Small: **FREE** (regular price ₹9/24h)

All regular India prices shown above are per 24 hours. International regular advertising rates start from **$2 USD per 24 hours**. During this offer, the booking price is ₹0 for eligible available slots, regardless of the regular price.

**📏 CARD SIZE GUIDE**

- **LARGE:** Most prominent card with a larger heading and text.
- **MEDIUM:** Balanced card with medium-sized text.
- **SMALL:** Compact card with smaller text.

**📋 WHAT DETAILS DO YOU NEED TO SEND?**

1. **Name:** Your name, creator name or business/brand name.
2. **Promotion link:** The direct URL of your website, social account, profile, channel, group, app or product.
3. **Description:** A short and truthful explanation of what you promote.
4. **Preferred position:** Choose Position 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5.
5. **Preferred size:** Choose Large, Medium or Small.
6. **Backup choice:** Another position or size in case your first choice is unavailable.
7. **Optional image:** A direct banner or image URL, if available.
8. **Country:** Your country, to help coordinate your request.

Do not send passwords, verification codes, payment details or sensitive personal information.

**✅ HOW TO CLAIM YOUR FREE SLOT**

1. Contact us by email or Telegram.
2. Send the required details and your preferred position and size.
3. We will review your link and check availability.
4. Wait for our reply confirming your booking.
5. Once confirmed, your promotion will run for the agreed 24-hour period.

**🏆 WHO GETS THE TOP POSITION?**

The first applicant to contact us with complete details and receive confirmation gets priority for the Top position. Sending a message alone does not reserve a slot. If the Top position has already been confirmed for someone else, you may request another available position.

**📊 SLOT AVAILABILITY**

Only five sponsored positions are offered at a time, with Large, Medium and Small size options. Slots may be booked by other applicants, so contact us to confirm what is available. We will not mark a slot as booked until its booking is confirmed.

**⚠️ CONTENT AND APPROVAL RULES**

- Your link must work and accurately represent what you promote.
- Promotions must be lawful, genuine and appropriate for a general audience.
- Scams, phishing, malware, impersonation, illegal products or services, and misleading claims are not accepted.
- You must have permission to promote the account, content or product you submit.
- Free placement does not mean FreeTV Garden endorses or guarantees the promoted account, product or service.
- All submissions are subject to review and approval.

**📩 APPLY NOW**

Email: contact.freetool@gmail.com
Telegram: https://t.me/abhijeet620380

Send your promotion details and preferred slot today to request a free 24-hour placement. The offer ends today at 11:59 PM India Standard Time, and all bookings require confirmation.

title: 📺 New: EPG (Electronic Program Guide)
body:
FreeTV Garden now supports EPG (Electronic Program Guide) for supported TV channels. 📅

- ▶️ See what's currently playing on supported channels.
- ⏭️ Check upcoming programs and schedules.
- 🗓️ View program listings for Today and Tomorrow.
- 🔄 EPG data updates automatically when fresh schedule information is available.
- 🕐 See when the EPG data was last refreshed.

⚠️ EPG is not available for every TV channel. Availability depends on whether program guide data is available for that channel.

EPG is not available for radio stations, webcams, or channels that stream through YouTube.

More channels will support EPG as program guide data becomes available.

title: 🌐 Channel Native Names Are Now Visible
body:
FreeTV Garden now shows a channel's native name when it differs from the main name, making it easier to recognize channels in their original language and script.

- 🏷️ Native names appear below the main channel name.
- 🔎 Search now matches both English and native channel names across all channel searches.
- 🌍 Smart search handles Latin accents, Arabic diacritics, and Arabic/Persian character variations.
- 📖 Arabic and Persian native names automatically display in the correct right-to-left direction.
- ⭐ Native names are also saved and refreshed with your Favorites.

Discover and find channels more easily in their original language! 📺🌍

title: 🎧 Play TV & Radio in the Background
body:
You can now keep any TV channel or radio playing in the background on FreeTV Garden, just like a music app. Continue listening while using other apps, browsing other tabs, or with your screen turned off. 📱🎶

For background playback to work properly, make sure **battery and background data usage are enabled for your browser on your device**.

title: 🌐 FreeTV Garden Now Available in 74 Languages
body: FreeTV Garden is now available in 74 languages! You can use the website in your native language, with translated menus, navigation, and page content. Simply open Select Language and choose your preferred language.

title: Important: Check Channel Availability
body:
TV channel availability can change at any time. Some channels may be temporarily unavailable because their original stream is offline, has changed, or is experiencing a technical issue.

**⚠️ An “Offline” label does not always mean the channel is unavailable.** Some channels may still be working even when they are initially marked Offline.

**If you see a channel marked Offline, click it and try playing it.** If the stream starts playing successfully, the channel status will be **updated automatically in real time** to show that the channel is working.

**🌍 Availability may also vary by region.** Some channels or streams may be restricted in certain countries or regions due to **geo-restrictions**, while the same channel may work normally for viewers in other regions.

If a channel does not play, it may be temporarily unavailable or restricted in your region. Please try again later or check whether the channel is available from another region.

If you find a channel that is playing but still incorrectly marked Offline, please report it to [contact.freetool@gmail.com](mailto:contact.freetool@gmail.com).
